faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Mangalagiri Nuclear Medicine Technologist Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the AIIMS Mangalagiri Nuclear Medicine Technologist posts is 24th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Nuclear Medicine Technologist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. in Life science or other Science, along with a one-year diploma in Medical Radiation and Isotope Techniques (DMRIT) or an equivalent qualification approved by AERB.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Nuclear Medicine Technologist position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Nuclear Medicine Technologist post is between 18 to 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Nuclear Medicine Technologist post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Nuclear Medicine Technologist post at AIIMS Mangalagiri.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the UR category?
faq.answer: The application fee for candidates belonging to the UR, OBC, and EWS categories is Rs. 1500.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes a Skill Test (if conducted), a Written Test (CBT), and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Nuclear Medicine Technologist post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be placed in Pay Level -5 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Andhra Pradesh apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from all over India are eligible to apply, provided they meet the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any relaxation in age for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, SC/ST candidates are eligible for an age relaxation of 5 years over and above the maximum age limit.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the AIIMS Mangalagiri official website or via the 'Official Notification PDF' link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
